general.notes: Family name XPBL-XXYY96-80D(A). XPBL-495596: 1490 nm TX / 1550 nm RX; XPBL-554996: 1550 nm TX / 1490 nm RX. Case operating temperature Commercial -10 to 70 °C (Tcase); Industrial -40 to 85 °C (Tcase). Power dissipation 1.5 W (Commercial, XPBL-XXYY96-80D) and 1.8 W (Industrial, XPBL-XXYY96-80DA). Center wavelength range λC: λ−7.5 to λ+7.5 nm (λ = room-temperature wavelength). Spectrum bandwidth (−20 dB) max 0.3 nm. Average launched power (laser off) max −30 dBm. Transmitter/receiver optical specs measured with RPBS 2^31−1 @ 10.3125 Gbps; receiver sensitivity and overload per Note (4) at BER ≤ 10^−12. Tx average power 0 to 4 dBm (XPBL-495596-80D(A)); −1 to 3 dBm (XPBL-554996-80D(A)). Supply ICC max 450 mA Commercial / 550 mA Industrial.
